description: After 25 years of keeping misconduct by law enforcement secret, this bill I helped negotiate to open misconduct records to the public has passed and will finally become law.Law enforcement officers already have one of the most difficult and dangerous jobs, so we must support our good officers who are trying to weed out the bad. In Hawaii there have been over 80 cases of officers suspended or discharged for unwarranted violence or assault, and over 100 cases of officers filing fraudulent reports

title: Our Bill Passes To Help Good Cops End Misconduct By Bad Cops
